responsibility: Defines the standard traversal interface for THIR trees by exposing a `Visitor` trait and default walk functions for expressions, statements, blocks, match arms, and patterns. This file coordinates recursive navigation through THIR node storage in `Thir`, specifying which child THIR nodes are visited for each `ExprKind`, `StmtKind`, and `PatKind` so analyses can override selected hooks while reusing the canonical walk.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/visit.rs`, which provides a generated visitor API over MIR with location/use-context information, and `ty/visit.rs`, which augments type visiting, this file is the straightforward recursive walker for THIR expression, statement, block, arm, and pattern nodes stored in `Thir`.
